text:
Sam (release-ops): deploybot flagged a p95 latency spike on /v2/generate at 21:04 UTC, suggests unpin to v2.3.3 or roll back. logs show 30s tails and intermittent 502s.
deploybot: Automated suggestion -> partial-unpin v2.3.3 for 5% traffic OR full-rollback to v2.3.2. Metric triggers: p95 > 1200ms for 3 consecutive windows.
Lee (oncall): can we confirm it's not a K/V cache regressor? Mika any quick checks?
Mika (infra): KV cache miss rate jumped ~12% at the same time. I can toggle read-through routing but that'll take ~3m.
Jordan (sre): Error budget alert fired (SRE): 502s increased from 0.2% to 1.8% in 10m. Not a pure latency-only issue.
Sam (release-ops): Options: 1) follow deploybot partial-unpin (staggered) to limit blast radius, 2) manual rollback pinned version (full) now, 3) wait for infra toggle. Need decision and customer comm plan.
Priya (pm): Customer-facing incidents team needs a heads-up if we roll back. If we do partial-unpin, let's include a short release note blurb. Carmen can you prep?
Carmen (prod-comm): On it. Draft: "We observed degraded generation latency for a subset of requests; routing adjustments are in progress. We're rolling back a recent inference bundle for affected traffic to restore performance. Customers on dedicated instances will be contacted separately." Will post once decision made.
Lee (oncall): My take — do partial-unpin 10% -> monitor 5m -> ramp to 50% if stable, else full rollback. Need someone to hit the manual-confirm button; I'm green to approve.
Sam (release-ops): I'll execute staggered unpin. Command: ```/deploy unpin --service inference --from v2.4.0 --to v2.3.3 --pct 10 --strategy staggered --reason "p95 latency spike"```
deploybot: Acknowledge. Initiating staggered-unpin 10% -> target v2.3.3. Will report step completions.
Mika (infra): I'll also run the KV routing toggle in parallel. If unpin doesn't help within 8m, we should rollback.
Jordan (sre): Monitoring: p95 and 502s dashboards linked -> https://graf.redwood/p/abc123. Setting an alert to ping this thread.
Sam (release-ops): Notifying support and sales: @here heading into partial unpin for 10%, customer comm draft ready. Carmen please coordinate with support ops.
Carmen (prod-comm): Tagging support lead to prep CS template. ETA 8m for first status update.
Priya (pm): Also add release notes line and update the change-log: "Temporary traffic-side rollback for latency stabilization".
Lee (oncall): If we see >1% 502s after the 10% unpin, I want manual full rollback authority handed to release-ops.
Sam (release-ops): Copy. Executing now. Will post progress and final status.
deploybot: Step 1 complete: 10% traffic rerouted to v2.3.3. Observability window starting.
Jordan (sre): Early signal: p95 dropped 18% on the unpinned slice, 502s down to 0.9% overall.
Sam (release-ops): Good sign. Monitoring closely. Will escalate if regression persists.
Carmen (prod-comm): Draft status update queued. Sending in 6m unless we escalate sooner. :writing_hand:
Mika (infra): KV toggle applied on 20% of hosts; watching for cache warm-up artifacts.
Sam (release-ops): If everything holds at 5m, we'll ramp another 40% per schedule. If not, we'll execute full rollback command: ```/deploy rollback --service inference --to v2.3.2 --reason "persistent latency/regressions"```
Lee (oncall): Acknowledged. Keep this thread as the single source of truth for exec steps and comms.
Sam (release-ops): updating on final: after 18m total, metrics are stable (p95 within SLO, 502s at baseline). Will continue ramp and close incident if stable after 60m.
Carmen (prod-comm): Sent customer-facing update. Will follow up with support notes and final incident summary.
Priya (pm): Thanks team. Postmortem requested if root cause != KV routing.
Sam (release-ops): Closing ops action: continue monitor, add postmortem owners: Sam, Mika, Jordan.
deploybot: Incident ticket auto-generated (#INC-2026).
